name: Matthew Ng
headline: Turning complex strategy and everyday workflow problems into working prototypes
bio: I am a London-based strategy consultant and builder with a background spanning management consulting, healthcare and life sciences, and biopharmaceutical research. Outside of client work, I use AI-assisted prototyping to turn everyday friction and curiosity into small, usable tools. Each coral on the left grows through 4 stages as ideas mature and lessons accumulate.
statusLine: Based in London, United Kingdom · MSc Management (LSE) · BSc Biochemistry (Imperial College London)
